messages:
jen: Quick heads-up — freeze window for the April launch starts 2026-04-01 00:00 UTC (72h). Please confirm no config or infra changes go out during the window. I'll paste the final readiness checklist below.

maria: ack. I'll block PRs that touch serving infra and alert owners.

sahil: any exceptions for urgent security patches? how do we handle rollbacks?

jen: exceptions allowed only for security fixes approved by Eng-ops + CSO. Rollbacks require an oncall + release lead sign-off. See checklist.

deploy-bot: [deploy plan attached] Release branch: release/2026-04-launch; pinned runtime: rwd-runtime-1.12.3; models pinned: lm-xl-v3@2026-03-25

oliver: Confirming model pinning — LM XL v3 @ 2026-03-25 is the serving image, fallback is lm-xl-v2-quant@2026-02-10.

maria: Posting final readiness checklist:
1) Code freeze confirmed by all service leads.
2) Pipelines green (CI badge: all). Current: unit 254/254, e2e 43/43.
3) Prod canary plan uploaded: /releases/2026-04/canary.md
4) Rollback playbook validated by oncall.
5) Ops runbook updated with contact list.

jen: add: pin third-party infra deps (vault, k8s) and double-check KMS rotation windows.

sahil: oncall ready. I've run a dry-run of the rollback playbook at 17:30 UTC — timing and steps good. I can be pager during freeze.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: 2026-04-01 01:00 UTC (canary), 2026-04-01 03:00 UTC (full). CI: green.

oliver: small note — console retention override will be disabled during freeze to avoid schema migrations. We'll stub telemetry if needed.

maria: I added a pinned message in #incidents with the change window and contact matrix.

jen: final ask — if you need a post-freeze hotfix, route via #eng-oncall and mention me + sahil. Otherwise we're locked. :lock:

oncall-bot: Incident reminder scheduled: 2026-04-01 00:15 UTC for oncall handoff.

sahil: everything else looks good from infra. I'm going to tag the PRs that need manual hold.

jen: thanks all. consider this the official "no-prod-changes" notice unless exception approved. :thumbsup:

maria: :thumbsup:

oliver: :rocket:
